Precondition: Serialized line with a MIP-integrated PLC; an open container/tray and an identified source LOT
Step: Run one part cycle: PLC asserts DataReady, MES reads PartSN
Expected Result: MES validates the serial (not duplicate, format valid, source LOT not on hold), writes PartValid=1, mints a SerializedPart, places it in the tray as a ContainerSerial, decrements the source LOT per BOM, and writes a Consumption genealogy edge

Precondition: A serial number already recorded in the system
Step: Present a duplicate (or bad-format) PartSN on the next cycle
Expected Result: MES writes PartValid=0 back to the PLC and rejects the part; no SerializedPart / ConsumptionEvent is written

Precondition: A serialized tray filled to its configured part count
Step: Complete the serialized tray
Expected Result: A finished-good LOT is minted (tray = LOT); every SerializedPart for the tray sets ProducingLotId to that LOT and each ConsumptionEvent targets it via ProducedLotId; ContainerSerial still pins each serial to its tray

Precondition: Operation template has RequiresMaterialVerification = true; a GOOD source LOT that is a BOM component
Step: Scan the source LOT's LTT barcode before production
Expected Result: BOM-based verification passes — item matches an active-BOM component, status GOOD, sufficient pieces — and the LOT is accepted as a consumption source

Precondition: A LOT whose item is NOT in the active BOM
Step: Scan the wrong-part LOT
Expected Result: System rejects the material with a clear wrong-part error and does not record consumption

Precondition: A wrong-part scan blocked by the strict BOM check
Step: A supervisor authorizes a one-shot BOM-substitute override via AD elevation
Expected Result: The scanned LOT is accepted despite the BOM mismatch; an Audit.OperationLog row captures the original BOM expectation, substitute, operator, supervisor, terminal, and timestamp

Precondition: Automation sets HardwareInterlockEnable=false
Step: Run a part cycle in bypass mode
Expected Result: MES accepts PartSN=NoRead, still records the production/serial, flags the NoRead for quality review, sets ContainerSerial.HardwareInterlockBypassed=1, and does NOT block production

Precondition: Non-serialized assembly cell; FG item eligible; component stock staged at the line
Step: Select the FG item from the eligibility dropdown and complete a tray
Expected Result: A finished-good LOT is minted (origin Manufactured, at the cell) whose PieceCount equals the closure-determined count; the tray references that LOT

Precondition: A minted FG tray with multiple component LOTs staged
Step: Inspect the component draw after tray completion
Expected Result: BOM components are consumed FIFO oldest-first by CreatedAt into the FG LOT; source LOTs are decremented (and closed at zero); a Consumption edge links each source to the FG LOT

Precondition: A tray whose BOM needs more component pieces than are staged
Step: Attempt to complete the tray
Expected Result: System refuses and names the short component(s) with need-vs-have (e.g. PartNumber (need X, have Y)); no FG LOT is minted

Precondition: A ByCount container config with a defined PartsPerTray
Step: Complete a tray whose parts count does not match PartsPerTray
Expected Result: System rejects the tray with a count-mismatch message; a matching count is required to close

Precondition: An open container being filled tray by tray
Step: Complete successive trays and watch the container running count
Expected Result: Each completed tray increments the container by PartsPerTray; the container reports FULL when accumulation reaches TraysPerContainer x PartsPerTray

Precondition: An open container already at its full target
Step: Attempt to complete another tray onto it
Expected Result: System refuses the tray and prompts to Complete/ship the full container before starting a new tray

Precondition: A completed non-serialized tray
Step: Inspect the ConsumptionEvent rows written for the tray
Expected Result: Each event is immutable and records source LOT, ProducedLotId = the FG LOT, consumed item, produced item, piece count, location, operator, terminal, tray, and timestamp

Precondition: A finished-good LOT minted from assembly
Step: Open the genealogy for the FG LOT
Expected Result: A Consumption genealogy edge + closure links the FG LOT back to every component LOT consumed (shape Container -> Tray -> FG LOT -> component LOTs); Honda trace resolves through the closure table

Precondition: A terminal with RequiresCompletionConfirm set
Step: Complete a full container at that terminal without confirming
Expected Result: Container_Complete refuses until the operator presses the large Confirm Completion gesture; a terminal without the attribute proceeds with a passive popup

Precondition: A WO configured for camera-count (or scale-weight) auto-finish
Step: Drive cumulative good count (or weight) to the target with the PLC CompletionConfirmed BIT asserted
Expected Result: WO auto-closes only when BOTH the count/weight crossing AND the PLC CompletionConfirmed BIT are true; the crossing alone does not close
Notes: WO subsystem CONDITIONAL; PLC commissioning / simulator

Precondition: A WO whose cumulative good count is not evenly divisible by PartsPerTray
Step: Attempt to close the WO
Expected Result: Close is blocked with "Work order target quantity exceeded. Ensure target quantity is evenly divisible by the tray quantity"; supervisor AD elevation overrides (reason logged)

Precondition: An assembly cell with no open container for the FG item
Step: Complete the first tray (non-serialized) or place the first serialized part
Expected Result: A Container is created automatically (assigned config, Open status) and begins filling

Precondition: A container progressing through its lifecycle
Step: Complete then ship a container; separately place one on hold / void one
Expected Result: Status is driven by ContainerStatusCode: Open -> Complete -> Shipped, with Hold and Void available for quality disposition

Precondition: A serialized line with an open container
Step: Place serialized parts through successive tray positions
Expected Result: Each part creates a ContainerSerial (container, tray, serial, position); the tray count advances at PartsPerTray and the container closes at TraysPerContainer

Precondition: A non-serialized line packing a container
Step: Fill and close trays until the container reaches capacity
Expected Result: ContainerTray rows are created as trays close and the container closes when configured capacity is reached

Precondition: A full open container with an available AIM shipper ID in the pool
Step: Complete the container
Expected Result: In one atomic local-DB transaction the container flips to Complete, claims the next FIFO AIM shipper ID, stores it on the container, and inserts a ShippingLabel row — no in-between state without an AIM ID

Precondition: A container whose accumulated parts exceed the configured target
Step: Attempt to complete the over-filled container
Expected Result: System refuses with a data-integrity error and leaves the container Open for remediation (never ships an over-target container under one AIM ID)
